rv.q: The show is at its strongest when it lets Jessie and Lina just exist as friends and new mothers.
This is a great comedy with dark edges, because it takes an honest look at being a parent, the power of female relationships, and the dilemma every working mother faces after having a child.

cn.t: This intimate production of "Cry It Out" resonates with its authentic portrayal of new motherhood, anchored by strong chemistry between lead actors Womack and Ru in a story that captures the isolation and connection of early parenting.
